watches.name: LE - Michel GMT - Ivory Meridian
watches.description: Ivory Meridian — The Golden Heritage Limited Edition - Only 5 pieces made Some watches tell the time. Others carry a piece of history. Inspired by my grandfather’s watch, the Ivory Meridian brings together a warm yellow gold case, a crisp white dial, and a deep black leather strap. Three timeless elements, brought together in a configuration that feels as relevant today as it did decades ago. There’s a quiet confidence in this combination. The gold catches the light, the white dial keeps everything clear, and the black strap brings it all back to earth. No excess, no distractions — just the enduring appeal of a classic. A tribute to the watches that came before us, and to the stories they carry forward. A piece of the past, made for the present.

watches.name: The Vinyl Electric Teal - AndoAndoAndo x Tessé
watches.description: Turn up the colour. AndoAndoAndo's Vinyl Record Watch has always been about the joy of music, the charm of a physical record and the fun of wearing something that makes people look twice. For this collaboration, we invited Tessé's world into Ando's. The result is the Vinyl watch reimagined in Tessé's unmistakable colours: Electric Teal and orange . Tessé's bold, architectural colour palette brings a new energy to Ando's playful interpretation of the record. The circular dial, inspired by the spinning surface of vinyl, becomes a meeting point between music and time, while the vibrant colours turn the watch into something unmistakably expressive. It is retro without being nostalgic. Playful without being ordinary. Ando brings the vinyl. Tessé brings the colour. Put it on, press play, and make some time to smile.

watches.name: Toronto Luxury Nubuck Leather travel roll
watches.description: The Toronto Luxury Designed for the collector who believes a watch travel case should be as considered as the timepiece it carries, The Toronto Luxury is a refined single-watch case crafted from black oiled nubuck leather. Soft to the touch and rich in character, the leather develops a subtle patina over time, giving each case its own character. Inside, a rich blue suede lining provides a soft, protective environment for your watch while introducing a restrained contrast to the deep black exterior. A removable padded cushion holds your watch securely and accommodates a range of case sizes, whether fitted with a bracelet, leather strap, rubber strap, or NATO. Rather than a conventional zipper, The Toronto Luxury uses discreet hidden push pins to secure the case while preserving its clean, uninterrupted silhouette. Every element is deliberately considered, from the tactile leather exterior to the contrast of blue suede within. Compact enough to slip into a travel bag, yet refined enough to leave on display, The Toronto Luxury protects your watch without compromising the experience of owning it. Exterior: Black Oiled Nubuck Leather Interior: Blue Suede Capacity: 1 watch

watches.description: Azure Signal – The Age of Jet Travel The 1970s marked the golden age of international jet travel. Airports expanded, time zones blurred, and bold color accents became essential visual signals guiding travelers across the world. The Azure Signal Michel GMT captures that spirit of movement and clarity. Its light grey sunburst dial provides a calm architectural backdrop, while the vivid turquoise GMT hand cuts across the dial like a navigational marker — bright, precise, and impossible to miss. Paired with a cut-to-size baby blue rubber strap, this summer-ready configuration introduces a lighter, more relaxed expression of the Michel GMT. A watch built for long days, open skies, and journeys that stretch beyond a single horizon.

watches.name: The Montreal Bagel Case
watches.description: If you're searching for a sleek, reliable travel case to protect your watch, look no further than The Montreal Bagel . Inspired by its namesake, The Bagel is a hard-shell watch case shaped like a bagel (or donut, if you prefer), designed to hold a single timepiece securely. Its indented center ensures that your watch head stays safely separated from any metal parts, whether it's fitted with a bracelet, leather strap, rubber strap, or NATO. Crafted with a durable ballistic nylon exterior, The Bagel safeguards your watch from impacts, while its soft fleece-lined interior prevents scratches. Two black foam inserts are included to keep your watch snug and secure during transport. The case features a sturdy zipper with an easy-to-grip rubber pull and comes with a carabiner for convenient attachment to your bag or loop. The Bagel comfortably fits watches up to 50mm in case size, with extra room for models like the Panerai PAM00111 (44mm) and MB&F LM101 (16mm thickness). Dimensions: 10cm x 10cm x 5.8cm Exterior: Navy Interior: Orange
